question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the underlined spelling error.

The rainbow only appears after a hurican.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (hurricane)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hurican"** is misspelled. It refers to a severe tropical storm, but the correct spelling is "hurricane." (तूफान)

 
 
• **Example:** The hurican caused widespread destruction across the coastal areas.
 
 
 
• **"Hurricane"** is the correct word that refers to a powerful tropical cyclone originating over warm ocean waters, characterized by strong winds and heavy rain. (तूफान)
 
 
• **Example:** The hurricane made landfall last night, causing significant damage.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling of the word is **"hurricane."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (hurricane)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **hurrecane** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of the word "hurricane."

 
 
• **Example:** Hurrecane is not the correct spelling.
 
 
 
• **hurrecain** (गलत वर्तनी): Another incorrect spelling of the word "hurricane."
 
 
• **Example:** Hurrecain is not recognized as a valid word in English.
 
 
 
• **hurican** (गलत वर्तनी): This is also an incorrect spelling of the word "hurricane."
 
 
• **Example:** Hurican is a misspelling of "hurricane."
